label: 1. Here comes the sound of fate which makes peopl…

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: Here comes the sound of fate which makes people emotional.

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: It's like raindrops hitting the surface of the lake.

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: What an exciting rhythm!

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: It's very good to see you, Conductor.

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: My name is Julia, and we'll be performing together in the future.
Conductor?

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: What's the matter, Conductor?
I'm not a Conductor.

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: Looks like the messages were sent to the wrong person

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: because I can't play with the flow of time yet.

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: Please excuse my rudeness.

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: May everything you do will be filled with joyful melodies.
Julia?
There is no response.
After a while.

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: Here comes the sound of fate which makes people...

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: Aren't you the one who replied to me a moment ago?

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: I was rude again.
No, I'm your Commander.

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: Really? So you are the Conductor!

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: That's a relief.
But why do you call me a Conductor?

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: That's because you face an enormous audience,

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: leading countless performers

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: and creating the melody being played on the battlefield.
It sounds like an exaggeration of what I do.

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text:
No, it's not an exaggeration. Besides,
I don't think it's enough to express your excellence.
Thank you.

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: I should be thanking you, Conductor.

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: I'm so delighted to be performing on the world's stage in the future with you.

lines.speaker: julia
lines.text: Let's give a remarkable performance together.
Likewise.
